rows.en: I'm expecting a lot from you, so give it your best.
There's no way we'll fail. I'm with you, after all.
I can trust you to watch my back.
I'm relying on you, so live up to it.
With skills like that, you'll get yourself killed someday.
I'm appalled. I never thought you'd be this useless.
Goodbye. Our partnership ends here.
Operation successful. We're heading back.
Well done. Keep it up like this next time, please.
I'm glad you made it back safely.
Don't worry. I'll cover you properly.
With your ability, success is only natural.
You can do it. I guarantee it.
I'm counting on you as my partner from now on, too.
This much is a given. You're the one I trust with my back.
I don't mind that reckless side of you.
Just don't drag me down.
Do you get it? This isn't an amusement park ride.
I'd be better off doing it alone.
Just worry about yourself.
I'll back you up, so go all out.
We'll make this operation a success, no matter what.
Back me up properly.
Let me see what you're really made of.
Live up to my expectations.
With you backing me up, I don't feel like I can lose.
There's no way we'll fail. You're my partner.
I'm trusting you with my back.
There won't be a next time. Thanks for your trouble.
rows.notes: Sarcastic otsukaresama on a failed mission.

rows.en: I never expected you to drag me down this much.
Honestly, I'm amazed you made it back.
Good work. I'm counting on you next time too.
Looks like it's a success. Let's head back.
You should be able to do even better.
With you, success is only natural.
Your skills weren't bad at all.
Looks like you don't need me to back you up anymore.
I think you and I could be great rivals.
I'm counting on you from now on too, my best partner.
rows.notes: Honorific -san on "best partner" dropped.

rows.en: You really saved me. Thanks.
The Minmay Defense is crumbling...
rows.notes: Transcript "minmei difensu" in wrong kanji: the Macross II song-broadcast defense tactic. "Minmay Defense" not in the glossary.

rows.en: Here I go!
I'm in a foul mood right now! Stay away if you know what's good for you!
Hibiki, is that you?
rows.notes: Transcript has "hibiki" as a common noun (echo); it is the name.

rows.en: Stop this foolishness!
rows.notes: Transcript "baka na made" is "baka na mane" (as 140).

rows.en: From here on, I can't guarantee you'll survive.
rows.notes: Same line as 303.

rows.en: I couldn't stand it. You saw them, didn't you? Those Zentradi.
rows.notes: She says "Zentran" (Macross II usage); glossary lists it as an alias of Zentradi.

rows.en: Sure, maybe they were born to fight. But they haven't thrown away their freedom. They're people, not tools of war.
That's why I want to bet on what Ishtar could do.
rows.notes: kanousei: Ishtar's potential.

rows.en: Well, it's easier to believe than some bogus newsman.
rows.notes: What is more believable is not said (Ishtar, or what Hibiki just said); "it" chosen. The "bogus newsman" is a dig at Hibiki.
Laugh only.

rows.en: I don't want to fight right now. Not with you people.
Damn! If only that kid weren't on board!
rows.notes: ano ko: gender not given; "kid" kept neutral.

rows.en: Right.
Mock battle or not, I'm not going easy on you.
Hibiki! What are you doing here!?
I lose today. But next time, I won't lose!
I'll be serving as your bridge operator. Pleased to work with you.
rows.notes: Shared MUF clip (MUF:vo0_of0_000): English carried over unchanged.

rows.en: I'm your bridge operator. Nice to meet you.
rows.notes: Shared MUF clip (MUF:vo0_of1_000): English carried over unchanged.

rows.en: From today I'm your operator. Pleased to meet you.
rows.notes: Shared MUF clip (MUF:vo0_of2_000): English carried over unchanged.

rows.en: I'll be your bridge operator. Let's work well together.
rows.notes: Shared MUF clip (MUF:vo0_om0_000): English carried over unchanged.

rows.en: This is bridge operator Misa Hayase.
rows.notes: Shared MUF clip (MUF:vos_mis_000): English carried over unchanged.

rows.en: I'll relay mission details and battle status from now on.
rows.notes: Shared MUF clip (MUF:vo0_of0_001): English carried over unchanged.

rows.en: I'll be briefing you on the mission and battle situation.
rows.notes: Shared MUF clip (MUF:vo0_of1_001): English carried over unchanged.

rows.en: I'll give the orders, so just do as I say.
rows.notes: Shared MUF clip (MUF:vo0_of2_001): English carried over unchanged.

rows.en: I'll relay mission info and battle status from now on.
rows.notes: Shared MUF clip (MUF:vo0_om0_001): English carried over unchanged.

rows.en: You will follow my instructions.
rows.notes: Shared MUF clip (MUF:vos_mis_001): English carried over unchanged.

rows.en: Beginning the operation now.
rows.notes: Shared MUF clip (MUF:vo0_of0_002): English carried over unchanged.

rows.en: Operation begins now.
rows.notes: Shared MUF clip (MUF:vo0_of1_002): English carried over unchanged.

rows.en: Operation begins now.
rows.notes: Shared MUF clip (MUF:vo0_om0_002): English carried over unchanged.

rows.en: Attention, pilots. Sortie at once. I repeat, sortie at once.
rows.notes: Shared MUF clip (MUF:vos_mis_002): English carried over unchanged.

rows.en: Operation start. All squadrons, go to combat stations.
rows.notes: Shared MUF clip (MUF:vo0_of0_003): English carried over unchanged.

rows.en: Operation start. All squadrons, enter combat readiness.
rows.notes: Shared MUF clip (MUF:vo0_of1_003): English carried over unchanged.

rows.en: The operation's starting!
rows.notes: Shared MUF clip (MUF:vo0_of2_003): English carried over unchanged.

rows.en: Operation start. All squadrons, go to combat readiness.
rows.notes: Shared MUF clip (MUF:vo0_om0_003): English carried over unchanged.

rows.en: Enemy closing fast! All units, combat readiness!
rows.notes: Shared MUF clip (MUF:vos_mis_003): English carried over unchanged.

rows.en: Oh, it's been a while. I look forward to working with you again.
rows.notes: Shared MUF clip (MUF:vo0_of0_004): English carried over unchanged.

rows.en: Oh, so it's you. I'll be looking after you again.
rows.notes: Shared MUF clip (MUF:vo0_of1_004): English carried over unchanged.

rows.en: Who the hell are you? Pretty chummy, aren't you? Kidding. You remember me, right?
rows.notes: Shared MUF clip (MUF:vo0_of2_004): English carried over unchanged.

rows.en: Operating for you again, huh. I'm counting on you.
rows.notes: Shared MUF clip (MUF:vo0_om0_004): English carried over unchanged.
